title: FlyRight — one place for the whole trip

headline: Every flight.
One place.
scenes.narration: Fly Right is the travel buddy you carry with you, and the journal you keep after.

headline: Everything,
in fixed places.
scenes.narration: Open the trip and everything sits in fixed places: the countdown, the terminal, check-in and gate, your seat and booking, and each step of the day as you pass it.

headline: Every route.
On a real earth.
scenes.narration: Every route you have flown sits on a globe we drew ourselves, lit by the real sun. The flight you are on rides its own line across it.

headline: Your world,
as a poster.
bullets: A glow where you fly most
scenes.narration: Share your world as a poster — story or square, dark or light, with a glow over the corridors you fly most, drawn on the phone's own GPU.

headline: A journal
that adds up.
scenes.narration: It all adds up: trips, airports, countries. Travel stats add your longest flight, your top destination, and the airline you fly most.

headline: Postcards
from the air.
scenes.narration: Updates is where your people are. Postcards from friends still in the air and just landed, each with the flight and the place it came from. Open one and you can follow their whole trip.

headline: Tap it.
Fill the screen.
scenes.narration: Tap a photo and it fills the screen, with a heart and a reply underneath.

headline: Who you follow.
Who follows you.
scenes.narration: Open a friend and you get their trip and their photos. Following is free, both ways.

headline: What you
are owed.
bullets: Raise the claim from the app
scenes.note: Sample delay · eligibility depends on the circumstances
scenes.narration: If a flight runs late, Fly Right works out what you are owed and helps you raise the claim, from the app.

headline: One place
for all of it.
scenes.narration: It all comes back to Flights — every trip, grouped by where you went.
